correctness.rationale: The Lindblad generator and initial state are explicitly stated. Positivity plus the nonzero nearest-neighbor couplings prove eventual absorption for every allowed parameter and guarantee integrability. All nine integrated-density equations are solved algebraically, establishing the exact mean-time identity. Its second derivative has a strictly positive factor for any nonzero detuning, and endpoint slopes give a complete unique global optimizer; threshold ordering is forced by strict convexity. A symbolic checker verifies all nine real equations and the second derivative; 900 independent nine-dimensional Liouvillian solves and 650 optimization checks agree. Finite tests are supplementary, not an infinite proof. Potential numerical instability near zero damping is excluded from the theorem, which remains algebraic.

originality.rationale: The claim concerns a specific, exact constrained noise-allocation optimizer. Classical three-site current calculations and noise-assisted transport are not claimed new. Closely related full texts for 2012, 2014, 2017 and 2026 were inspected at the level of model assumptions and mathematical implications. Their uniform/noise-at-different-sites or perturbative formulas do not state or imply the unrestricted endpoint fixed-budget formula or its sharp three-way optimum under the present assumptions. Semantic literature and database searches found no matching stronger statement. Residual priority risk from unindexed or specialized past work remains.
residual_risks: Search coverage is incomplete; an unindexed specialized three-level transport article may contain an equivalent exact endpoint-dephasing optimization.
The 2026 site-dependent-noise paper studies a nearby but different dephasing allocation. Its future mathematical extensions or alternate analytical forms could reduce the degree of novelty.
The result is for one minimal single-excitation network and is not automatically universal for larger systems.

value.rationale: Noise resources are constrained in transport engineering, making the spatial allocation at fixed dephasing budget a natural design problem. The exact mean-time law, global strict convexity, three distinct optimization phases, and two sharp detuning thresholds specify when environmental noise belongs on the injection endpoint, on the collection endpoint, or must be divided. These are not generic textbook monotonicity claims: a nontrivial parameter-dependent change of optimal control is proved without perturbation. The value is an exact complete classification for a physically motivated minimal system; extrapolation is not asserted.
